description: ArcGIS CityEngine is Esri's procedural 3D city generator for creating and iterating urban environments and scenarios from synthetic or real-world GIS data, aimed at urban designers, planners, architects and 3D artists. Procedural rules let users change architectural style, floor plans, size and textures quickly, generate several versions of a design, and view structures in context to check zoning requirements, natural resource protection, viewsheds and other factors. The Get Map Data function imports public or private basemap and terrain data, and CityEngine reads shapefiles, geodatabases, CAD and BIM; models scale from simple designs to detailed ones and connect to ArcGIS and to game engines and animation tools for immersive scenes and interactive simulations. Coverage: generic. Access: free trial, then purchase through Esri. Licence: commercial. Caveats: procedural models are design scenarios, not surveyed buildings, unless built from real footprints and attributes. Simulation uses: generating plausible 3D building stock for development scenarios, visibility and zoning studies, and synthetic cities for testing models. Related records: ArcGIS Urban, the OGC CityGML standard and the 3D City Database.
